chunks: "Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has prescribed for the people in wudu (ablution) that the woman should begin with the inner part of her forearm, and the man with the outer part of the forearm."

key_terms.ٱلْوُضُوءِ: wudu (ablution), the ritual washing before acts of worship

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام say about how men and women begin washing the arm in wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the manner of performing wudu (ablution). It states a distinction in how washing the forearm begins for women and men, presenting this as a prescribed ruling from Allah, Mighty and Majestic.
